 Coram: Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Rajnesh Oswal, Judge

Prayer made in the present petition is for directing transfer of the investigation in FIR No.
53/2022 dated 10.10.2022 registered with Cyber Police Station, Jammu under Section 66-D of Information Technology Act, 2000 read with Section 420 and 120-B IPC to an independent agency preferably respondent No. 2.
2.

On the previous date of hearing, the Co-ordinate Bench of this Court has observed that the Investigating Agency has done a wonderful job while investigating the present case, as such, no fruitful purpose shall be served by handing over the investigation to any other agency.

Accordingly,
the present petition is disposed of by directing the Investigating Officer to conclude the investigation as expeditiously as possible.
(RAJNESH OSWAL) JUDGE Jammu 07.02.2025 Neha-II Vijay Kumar vs Ut Of J&K And Ors on 7 February, 2025
